title: How Do We Extract the “Why” from a PR into a CHANGELOG with Jev? 🤔
why_read: A practical dev-tool deep dive on using an LLM to reliably extract the 'why' behind a code change for changelog generation.
analysis: This post describes a real engineering problem: automatically extracting the rationale behind a pull request to populate changelog entries, which is harder than extracting the surface-level 'what changed' because reasons are often implicit or missing. The author is building a tool called changelog-bot and explicitly tries to avoid letting the AI invent plausible-sounding but false justifications, which is a sensible and non-trivial constraint on LLM-based summarization. This is a useful, grounded example of applying language models carefully to a developer workflow problem rather than hype-driven AI usage. It's a niche tool but the underlying problem of faithful summarization versus hallucinated justification is broadly relevant.
